title: Learning pharmacokinetic dynamics with structured neural ODEs for precision dosing
abstract: arXiv:2602.03215v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Individualized dosing requires predicting how a patient's drug exposure would change under a different dose or schedule. However, a model that accurately predicts exposure at the current dose may not reliably predict what happens when treatment changes. We developed two neural models that learn pharmacokinetic dynamics from data without predefined pharmacokinetic equations. The first predicts exposure after a dose change, while the second also allows changes in dosing schedules. In simulations, the second model predicted exposure under new dosing schedules more accurately than competing neural models. On real data of kidney transplant recipients treated with tacrolimus, both models showed lower prediction errors than Bayesian estimation when predicting exposure at a later visit. These findings suggest that incorporating pharmacokinetic principles into neural models can improve predictions needed for individualized dosing.

translated_title: 基于结构化神经常微分方程学习药代动力学动态以实现精准给药
translated_abstract: 个体化给药需要预测患者的药物暴露量在不同剂量或给药方案下将如何变化。然而，能够准确预测当前剂量下药物暴露量的模型，未必能可靠预测治疗方案改变后的情况。我们开发了两种无需预先定义药代动力学方程、直接从数据中学习药代动力学动态的神经模型。第一种模型预测剂量改变后的药物暴露量，第二种模型还允许给药方案发生变化。在仿真实验中，第二种模型在预测新给药方案下的药物暴露量方面比其他竞争的神经模型更准确。在他克莫司治疗的肾移植受者真实数据上，两种模型在预测后续就诊时的药物暴露量方面，均表现出低于贝叶斯估计的预测误差。这些发现表明，将药代动力学原理融入神经模型可以改善个体化给药所需的预测。
tldr: 该研究提出了两种无需预定义药代动力学方程、直接从数据学习药代动力学动态的结构化神经ODE模型，可准确预测剂量或给药方案改变后的药物暴露量，在仿真和肾移植患者真实数据上均优于贝叶斯估计等现有方法，为个体化精准给药提供了新工具。
